text:
Rik: quick heads-up — noticed the in-product docs panel uses 'route' while the glossary and examples use 'endpoint'. surprised this slipped through our last pass :grimacing:
Maria (Docs): oof. which panel? can you paste screenshot or link? we should standardize to one term across UI + docs.
Rik: Console > Routes > Create flow, the help sidecar says 'Add a route' but the reference article calls it 'Create an endpoint'. file: /console/routes/create
Devon - Eng: thanks, tagging this for the routing UI rev. naming mismatch could break our crosslinking rules (we match anchors by slug).
Maria (Docs): agree. proposal: standardize on 'endpoint' — it's more familiar to users. Update sidecar copy and article headings. Also add an inline crosslink from the panel to the exact subsection in docs.
Amanda (A11y): quick A11y nit — when the panel opens and a crosslink is clicked, focus doesn't move to the destination, and screen-reader doesn't announce that content changed. we need aria-live or programmatic focus.
Devon - Eng: good catch. for single-page nav we can add: focus management + update url hash. sample snippet:
```
// after link click
document.getElementById(targetId).focus();
history.replaceState(null, '', '#'+targetId);
```
Also add `aria-hidden` toggles on the panel.
Maria (Docs): i'm going to edit the help article headings and add an alias line at the top: "endpoint (aka route)" so old links still make sense.
Rik: can we also add a small 'open in docs' icon next to section headers in the sidecar that does a deep link? users often expect that.
Devon - Eng: doable. question: should links open in a new tab or navigate within console? current behavior is in-app navigation.
Amanda (A11y): prefer same-tab navigation but ensure focus lands on main content and that the panel is closed before focus shift. aria-label on the link should be explicit, e.g. `aria-label="Open documentation for Create endpoint (opens in new tab)"` if new tab used.
Maria (Docs): i'll draft new microcopy and update the inline link pattern. also will add a short glossary note at top of the docs page.
Rik: cool. can someone file a short ticket with acceptance criteria? (copy update, sidecar link behavior, focus management, analytics event for click)
Devon - Eng: filing now — PR will include unit test for focus and an e2e for deep link behavior. ticket #INFR-2042
docs-bot: created INFR-2042: "Console docs panel — terminology alignment + deep-link accessibility fixes" assigned to Devon, due 2 weeks.
Maria (Docs): thanks — i'll follow up with the copy PR and a list of all pages where 'route' appears so we can batch replace.
Rik: thanks all :thumbsup:
